cohort: A 37-year-old female with a history of lower segment caesarean section four years previously, presenting with discharge from an abdominal incision.
finding: Uterocutaneous fistula is a rare delayed complication of LSCS, and MRI plays a definitive role in its accurate diagnosis and delineation.
mod_finding: Mode of birth (Lower Segment Caesarean Section) is associated with the rare delayed complication of uterocutaneous fistula.
